newsitem.title: USA: US High Court denies Texas Instruments patent case.
newsitem.headline: US High Court denies Texas Instruments patent case.

text.p: The U.S. Supreme Court denied Monday a Texas Instruments Inc appeal arising from its 1990 lawsuit alleging that three other companies infringed its patents involving certain semiconductor technology.
The lawsuit named Cypress Semiconductor Corp, LSI Logic and VLSI Technology Inc, alleging they had violated two Texas Instruments patents for encapsulating a semiconductor in plastic.

A jury initially awarded Texas Instruments $51.8 million. But the amount then was thrown out by a federal judge in a decision upheld by a U.S. appeals court, who found that companies did not infringe the patents.
Texas Instruments asked the Supreme Court to hear arguments in the case and to reverse the appeals court ruling, but the justices rejected the appeal without any comment or dissent.
